title: Industry Pulse — AI / Agent Ecosystem

bullets.title: Anthropic ships "Reflect" — a usage-insight dashboard inside Claude
bullets.summary: Reflect (Jul 9, beta for Free/Pro/Max with memory on) visualizes what you use Claude for, your AI-usage patterns, and adds quiet-hours / break nudges.
bullets.how: The consumer framing isn't ours, but the primitive — per-user/agent usage analytics over a memory store — is exactly the observability layer The Construct needs across its own agent fleet; watch for an export/API surface we can point at Construct usage.

bullets.title: OpenAI's GPT-5.6 (Sol/Terra/Luna) goes fully GA across ChatGPT, API, and Codex
bullets.summary: Jul 9 ends a 13-day government-coordinated preview; Sol is OpenAI's strongest coding/agentic tier and is now callable from the API and Codex.
bullets.how: A routing-layer input: bench Sol against Sonnet 5 / Opus 4.8 and Grok 4.5 for Construct coding + computer-use jobs, but keep provider-agnostic routing so it's a config change, not a rebuild.

bullets.title: Apple ships a Safari MCP server (Safari Technology Preview 247)
bullets.summary: The built-in MCP server lets an AI agent emulate what a real user experiences on a site and feed that back for debugging.
bullets.how: A browser-native agent QA loop maps to Brand 9 Signs web + digital-signage front-ends: an agent could validate rendering/UX of client microsites and kiosk pages without a bespoke harness.

bullets.title: Featured ships an MCP server for PR agencies — vertical agency MCPs are now landing
bullets.summary: Featured (AI co-pilot for PR) made its MCP server GA (Jul 7), letting Claude/Cursor/VS Code drive PR/earned-media workflows directly from an MCP-compatible client.
bullets.how: First-mover proof that agency-vertical MCPs are appearing; maps straight to B9/PRAGMA's owned-presence + earned-media wedge. Evaluate wrapping it behind Pulse for client PR ops.

bullets.title: MCP 2026-07-28 spec RC + beta SDKs land — stateless core, MCP Apps (server-rendered UI), Tasks, deprecation policy
bullets.summary: The biggest protocol revision since launch is now RC with beta SDKs; the stateless core runs behind plain HTTP load balancers, and Claude, ChatGPT, VS Code/Copilot and Goose already run MCP Apps.
bullets.how: The stateless core is friendly to our failure mode (scans dying when a session/host closes), and MCP Apps means server-rendered UI could feed the V4 dashboard directly. Pin the version Construct agents speak and schedule the migration ahead of the Jul 28 final.

praxis_lesson: Jul 9 was the first day three frontier labs each had a GA model live at once (OpenAI Sol, xAI Grok 4.5, with Gemini 3.5 Pro slipping to Jul 17) — the model tier is commoditizing on a weekly cadence, so the durable edge stays in the orchestration + integration layer we own. Meanwhile Anthropic's Reflect and Apple's Safari MCP show platform vendors racing to own two layers we depend on — usage observability and browser-agent QA — so adopt those surfaces where they exist rather than rebuild them, and concentrate original work on provider-agnostic routing and owned MCP orchestration (wrap vertical MCPs like Featured behind Pulse).
